visible_text: マイク と 画面の音 を聞いています
決まったことを待っています…
やることを待っています…
まだ発話がありません。

answers.q1: Partially. It states the audio source explicitly ('マイクと画面の音を聞いています' — listening to mic and screen audio), so I know it's capturing a live call. But WHICH meeting is unclear: the only title is '01:53 の会議' (a generic timestamp-based label), with no calendar name, participant list, or source app (Zoom/Meet/Teams) shown, so I can't tell what meeting this actually is.
answers.q2: No. There's a line at the bottom, 'AI が見ている資料' (material the AI is looking at), but it shows no file names, thumbnails, or count — just the label itself. I can't tell if any document is currently attached or if this is an empty/inactive state.
answers.q3: Mostly one surface, but not fully convincing. The rounded panel with transcript/summary/chat reads as a single app window, but the small dark pill at the very top (record/pause/comment/expand/more/stop icons) floats above and overlaps the panel's edge, looking like a separate floating control bar or mini-window rather than part of the same surface.
answers.q4: The recording status ('録音中 00:02') paired with what it's listening to, and the live transcript/summary panel on the right — that's the core 'is it working and what is it capturing' signal a first-time user would look for.
answers.q5: Several things: (1) '01:53 の会議' is ambiguous — unclear if it's a duration, timestamp, or placeholder title. (2) 'AI が見ている資料' shows no actual content, so it's unclear if any material is loaded. (3) The floating top toolbar visually detaches from the main panel. (4) The left panel's '決まったこと'/'やること' sections and the right panel's '決定事項'/'アクション' buttons seem to cover the same concepts (decisions, action items) without it being clear if they're the same data or separate features.

weaknesses.what: Meeting is identified only by a generic timestamp title ('01:53 の会議'), with no meeting name, participants, or source app shown.
weaknesses.fix: Surface the actual meeting title (from calendar or the captured app/window) next to or instead of the timestamp.

weaknesses.what: 'AI が見ている資料' gives no visible evidence of any material — no file name, icon, or count — so it reads as an inert label rather than live status.
weaknesses.fix: Show attached document names/thumbnails when present, and an explicit 'no material' state when empty.

weaknesses.what: The floating toolbar pill at the top overlaps the main panel's edge and has its own rounded shape/shadow, reading as a separate floating window stacked on top rather than part of the same surface.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the toolbar flush into the main panel's frame or reduce its independent styling so it reads as one continuous surface.

weaknesses.what: '決まったこと'/'やること' sections on the left and '決定事項'/'アクション' buttons on the right appear to duplicate the same concepts (decisions, action items) without clarifying if they show the same or different data.
weaknesses.fix: Merge into a single decisions/actions area, or visually distinguish the button's role (e.g., 'jump to' vs. a separate feature) from the panel content.
